prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ONLY_CWT_rf', seasonality_champion='ONLY_FT_catboost', recommended_method='median_or_trimmed_mean'. Narrative: ONLY_CWT_rf achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) while ONLY_FT_catboost leads seasonality capture (0.389), but CWT_rf wins overall RMSE (1.0865). Rankings are highly unstable (Kendall τ=-0.31) with concept drift detected, and trend/seasonality champions split across different models. ARIMA excels at early horizons (0.5982 RMSE) while ONLY_DWT_catboost dominates late horizons (0.8396 RMSE). Given unstable rankings and high model disagreement, robust median/trimmed_mean combination is recommended over stacking to avoid overfitting noise.
